info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Treasury By Param1-spec
info.description: The Corporate Treasury Analysis API provides insights into treasury operations by allowing users to retrieve detailed analysis based on specified parameters. This API is crucial for financial analysts and corporate treasurers who need to assess liquidity, manage risks, and optimize cash reserves. By providing data through the specified 'param1', users can tailor their queries to acquire relevant financial metrics and trends. Typical consumers include finance departments and treasury management systems seeking to enhance data-driven decision-making.

get.summary: Retrieve Corporate Treasury Analysis by ID
get.description: Fetches detailed information and analysis from the corporate treasury database for the specified resource ID. The data includes various financial metrics and insights relevant to treasury management, aiding in informed decision-making.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve corporate treasury analysis data specific to the RES-100045 operation. The data returned by this operation can include various financial metrics and indicators relevant to corporate treasury management.
